description: geoportaaloverijssel.nl: natural hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportaaloverijssel.nl. Coverage: the area served by geoportaaloverijssel.nl. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about natural hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Overstromingsdiepte middel grote kans nabij rivieren; Hittestress door warme nachten 2050 hoog; Hittestress door warme nachten huidig; Bodemdaling in 2050 bij scenario doorgaan. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
